why: Both analyses land on the same hedgehog as the key (superstores in regional clusters, measured by profit per region), the same stop-doing core (end tax-driven acquisitions, exit leased departments, stop running a patchwork of formats) and two of the key's three brutal facts. Analysis 2 edges ahead on calibration with an explicit confidence statement and an honest note about what it could not do, and its dated format-decision debate and no-new-capital fix-or-exit rule for the acquired chain are slightly more actionable for the leader.
